notes.title: Update 5.252 Release Notes
notes.content:
[list]
[*]The initial MP and MP recovery speed of mechs have been readjusted
       The initial maximum MP of all mechs is 100, different types of mechs have their own MP recovery speed

[*]All skills have been rebalanced
       The number of points needed for skills has now dropped
       The cooldown of most skills has been reduced
       The MP consumption of skills has been adjusted to the appropriate value now

[*]The initial movement speed of most mechs has been increased
[*]The total number of ammo has increased significantly
[*]The maximum range of Shot Cannon and Sakura has reduced
[*]The initial range of Snipe Cannon class mechs has increased
[*]Snipe Cannon class mechs now have a range of explosion to deal with a large number of monsters
[*]The warm-up time before firing of Tyrant has been reduced
[*]Each map has its own background music now
[*]Fixed the evolutionary route bug of mech technology tree
[*]Some UI had been improved
[/list]
